# 9 · Wheel Install

## At a glance

| | |
|---|---|
| **You'll do** | Fit the 4 handed mecanum wheels to the drive-pod hubs |
| **Prerequisites** | [Base Frame](base-frame.md) drive pods built |
| **Handedness** | 2 × LEFT-slant + 2 × RIGHT-slant — get the roller orientation right |

!!! note "Stub — assembly steps coming"
    Install the four mecanum wheels onto the drive hubs. The wheels are **handed** (2 left-slant,
    2 right-slant) and the roller direction must be correct for mecanum motion.

!!! tip "Why the wheels went on last"
    The [Base Frame](base-frame.md) build deliberately deferred the wheels — they get in the way
    of the earlier steps and lift the frame off the bench. Installing them here also gates the
    [OTOS install](otos.md), which needs ground clearance (or the robot jacked up).

*Assembly steps and photos to be added.*
